name: MonarchProseStyle
title: Prose
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle and androidx.compose.ui.text.TextLinkStyles for androidx.compose.material3.Text with AnnotatedString content, laid out by MonarchProse in an androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
summary: Type styles for long-form content (help articles, release notes, rendered Markdown, comments and documents): a base size, a reading measure, the look of each kind of block and the styling of links inside text, with MonarchProse to lay the blocks out.
whenToUse: For text the app does not lay out element by element: release notes, help articles, Markdown from a comment or a CMS, after the app's renderer has split it into blocks.
whenNotToUse: For interface text use MonarchText with a type role. For a single code fragment in a sentence use MonarchInlineCodeStyle; for a code block with copy and line numbers use MonarchCodeBlock. For HTML use a WebView: Monarch renders no HTML.
api: class MonarchProseStyle(size: MonarchProseSize = MonarchProseSize.Md, limitLineLength: Boolean = true) { @Composable fun bodyStyle(): TextStyle; @Composable fun headingStyle(level: Int): TextStyle; @Composable fun linkStyles(): TextLinkStyles }
enum class MonarchProseSize { Sm, Md, Lg }
@Composable fun MonarchProse(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, style: MonarchProseStyle = MonarchProseStyle(), content: MonarchProseScope.() -> Unit)

interface MonarchProseScope { fun heading(text: AnnotatedString, level: Int = 2); fun heading(text: String, level: Int = 2); fun paragraph(text: AnnotatedString); fun paragraph(text: String); fun listItem(text: AnnotatedString, marker: String? = null, depth: Int = 0); fun listItem(text: String, marker: String? = null, depth: Int = 0); fun quote(text: AnnotatedString); fun code(text: String); fun caption(text: String); fun rule() }

options.name: size
options.description: The base size: Sm (14sp) for comments, chat and side panels, Md (16sp) for documents, Lg (18sp) for long reads. Headings, code and spacing are multiples of it.

options.name: limitLineLength
options.description: Limits the column to the reading measure, 42 base sizes (672dp at Md and the default font size), at the start edge. Turn it off when the container already sets the width.

options.name: modifier
options.description: MonarchProse: the modifier of the column.

options.name: style
options.description: MonarchProse: the base size and the measure.

options.name: content
options.description: MonarchProse: adds the blocks in reading order with heading, paragraph, listItem, quote, code, caption and rule.

options.name: level
options.description: heading and headingStyle: 1 to 6, clamped. Level 1 is 1.875 times the base size; level 6 is the base size in the muted color.

options.name: marker
options.description: listItem: a number or letter such as "2.", read by TalkBack; null draws a bullet, which TalkBack skips.

options.name: depth
options.description: listItem: the nesting level; each level indents by 1.5 base sizes and nested bullets are rings.

states.name: default
states.description: Prose has no states of its own. Links keep the behavior of their LinkAnnotation; code blocks scroll sideways.

appearance: Running text in the default text color with relaxed leading; semibold headings with tight or snug leading; list markers and quotations in the muted color with a strong border bar at the start of a quotation; code blocks in the code face on the subtle background with a subtle border; rules in the subtle border color. Links use the link color and are underlined. High contrast themes use their stronger roles.
platformNotes: The parity map named MonarchTypography as the type; MonarchTypography holds the nine interface type roles and has no long-form styles, so this entry adds MonarchProseStyle, the name iOS uses, with MonarchProse to space the blocks. The web Prose styles HTML elements by tag; on Android the app's renderer (or the app) says which kind each block is through MonarchProseScope, and the inline parts (links, bold, inline code) are runs of an AnnotatedString, styled with linkStyles() and MonarchInlineCodeStyle. Rendering HTML and parsing Markdown are out of scope. Compose has no heading levels in its semantics, so every heading is a heading to TalkBack without its level. Not offered: tables, images, figures, definition lists, details and keyboard keys inside prose (use Material 3 and MonarchKbd directly), ProseExclude (other composables placed next to MonarchProse keep their own styles) and the as parameter. The web's base size is called Md, following the shared size vocabulary.
accessibility: A heading has heading semantics, so TalkBack's heading navigation moves through the document.
Each block is its own element, so TalkBack reads the content block by block.
A bullet is hidden from TalkBack; a numbered or lettered marker is read with its item as one element.
The quotation bar and rules are hidden from TalkBack.
Every size is in sp and spacing follows the font size, so prose scales with the font size setting and text wraps; code blocks scroll sideways instead.
Code blocks read left to right in a right-to-left layout; everything else follows the layout direction.
edgeCases: Heading levels outside 1 to 6 are clamped.
Long words wrap inside the column; long code lines scroll inside their block.
MonarchProse does not scroll; place it in a scrolling container or a LazyColumn item.
A negative list depth counts as 0.
Links need a LinkAnnotation with linkStyles() in the AnnotatedString; plain text in paragraph(String) has no links.
